title: Link persistence journal cannot detect complete deletion or signed revision rollback
description: Final ACK security review: python/src/lichen/link/link_layer.py:1280-1283 treats a completely absent slot/anchor set as a clean first boot, and the anchor-missing path accepts any signed revision-1 slot. An attacker or fault that deletes the current files (or restores a previously captured signed revision-1 slot while removing the anchor/newer slot) resets inbound replay floors, pins, retired-key lineage, and TX counters on restart. The journal signature proves authenticity but not freshness because its anchor is rollbackable in the same storage domain. Add an explicit authenticated virgin/bootstrap decision plus a monotonic anti-rollback anchor supplied independently of the journal (or a fail-closed equivalent), and test complete deletion, anchor deletion plus old rev1 restoration, full old journal restoration, normal first boot, and crash at each slot/anchor write boundary.
